items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I went to Japan with Ray Brown, Hank Jones and Alan Dawson. And we did a recording over there that is a CD.

ctx.x: Yeah. It sounds beautiful off of the LP you know?

Yeah, wow. There’s some student from Italy that came over here and he thought I was like Charlie Parker, “You’re a genius” blah-blah-blah. Anyhow he wanted to get a copy of this Catalyst thing. And I have so much clutter in my place that I couldn’t reach it, I don’t know where it is. It’s somewhere. But I have to send him a copy I think. The other thing is I did an album, I went to Japan with Ray Brown, Hank Jones and Alan Dawson. And we did a recording over there that is a CD. And he was supposed to send me a…
Who were the other jazz players that you’ve listened to and enjoyed or not enjoyed?
